name: a11ign-monorepo
description: Judge the real assistive-technology experience of a website with AI: drive a real screen reader through real navigation and assess whether the experience is coherent and usable.

engines.npm: use pnpm instead: run pnpm install

scripts.test: node scripts/pnpm.ts run test:ts && node scripts/pnpm.ts run test:python
scripts.test:python: if [ -x .venv/bin/pytest ]; then PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 .venv/bin/pytest -p no:cacheprovider packages/*/tests -q; else echo "SKIPPED: no .venv/bin/pytest — python tests need it. This is an honest skip, not a pass."; fi
scripts.prepare: node scripts/install-git-hooks.ts && node scripts/pnpm.ts -r run build
scripts.gate:lab-held: node -e "console.error(\"REFUSED: \" + process.argv.slice(1).join(\", \") + \" are held by a11ign/lab since ADR 0045 cut 9 (#5087), and this repository cannot run them: this chain does not claim they passed. Run them from the lab checkout; the open row that owns them is #4425.\"); process.exit(1)"
scripts.release:gate:ci: node scripts/pnpm.ts run scorer:migration && node scripts/pnpm.ts run gate:isolation
scripts.release:gate: node scripts/pnpm.ts run scorer:migration && node scripts/pnpm.ts run gate:isolation && node scripts/pnpm.ts run gate:lab-held -- scorer:verify release:provenance scorer:shortcuts corpus:distribution training:check-signals:complete rules:gate rules:coverage rules:real-pages training:evaluate-acceptance:shipped gate:nvda-release eval:gate
scripts.candidate:gate: node scripts/pnpm.ts run scorer:migration -- --evaluating && node scripts/pnpm.ts run scorer:retired-heads && node scripts/pnpm.ts run gate:isolation && node scripts/pnpm.ts run gate:lab-held -- scorer:shortcuts training:check-signals:complete rules:gate rules:coverage rules:real-pages
